jobs.title: Activation Brand Manager - FTC 12 months
jobs.description:
This hybrid opportunity in Zaventem, Belgium offers the chance to help shape growth across Kellanova’s iconic portfolio in Belgium and the Netherlands.

The Activation Brand Manager will play a key role in developing winning brand and shopper activation plans, bringing consumer-centric thinking, commercial insight, and flawless execution to every initiative while partnering closely with cross-functional teams across Marketing and Sales. This role is a fixed term contract for 12 months.

Working at the intersection of brand strategy, trade marketing, and consumer activation, this role is responsible for translating business priorities into impactful market execution. The successful candidate will combine creativity with analytical thinking to drive brand visibility, shopper engagement, and commercial performance across Belgium and the Netherlands, helping to deliver sustainable growth across multiple categories and channels.

A Taste of What You’ll Be Doing

- Leading Shopper Activation Strategies: Manage external agencies, lead briefings, and oversee the design and development process to build effective Path to Purchase strategies.

- Developing Trade Marketing Excellence: Partner closely with the Sales team to create and execute best-in-class trade marketing plans for key retail customers.

- Driving In-Store Visibility: Develop, adapt, and implement visibility tools, point-of-sale materials, and promotional activations that increase brand awareness and stimulate sales at the point of purchase.

- Analysing Brand Performance: Monitor and evaluate monthly product and category performance, using market data and business insights to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.

- Managing Marketing Investment: Oversee the A&P budget, ensuring marketing investments are effectively allocated and tracked. Manage invoice processing, maintain budget accuracy, and support strong financial governance while maximizing return on investment.

We’re Looking for Someone With

- Experience in Shopper Marketing, Consumer Activation, Product Management, Trade Marketing, or Brand Management within the Benelux market.

- Proven experience developing and executing BTL plans from both a consumer and shopper perspective.

- Strong analytical skills with previous experience using Nielsen and/or IRI tools to generate insights and support decision-making.

- Fluency in English, with French and/or Dutch language skills required.

- Experience managing marketing budgets, tracking spends and overseeing invoicing processes.

What’s Next

Need assistance throughout the application or hiring process? Email Andrew.Fisher@Kellanova.com

jobs.title: Stage Assistant(e) Category Manager Enseignes
jobs.description:
Derrière chaque bol de Trésor, Coco Pops ou Special K se cachent des stratégies commerciales qui façonnent les rayons de nos enseignes partenaires. En rejoignant notre équipe en tant que Stagiaire Assistant(e) Category Manager Enseignes, vous participerez à ces réflexions stratégiques au cœur du business. À la croisée du marketing, des ventes et du Revenue Growth Management, ce stage de 6 mois à partir du 4 janvier 2027 vous donnera une vision complète du Category Management et de l'univers passionnant de la grande distribution.

Dans ce poste vous pourrez travailler de manière hybride dans nos bureaux flambants neufs au Kartier Général de Boulogne-Billancourt. En plus d’un environnement de travail moderne, vous profiterez de nombreux avantages : prise en charge à 75% de votre titre de transport, tickets restaurant, accès au restaurant d’entreprise avec une variété de choix (sushi, italien, bar à salade…), open breakfast, accès à la salle de sport, ainsi qu’un jour de congé par mois travaillé.

Un Avant-Gout De Ce Que Vous Ferez

-

- Analyse et suivi du business - Analyse des performances des catégories et des innovations sur vos enseignes via les panels (CIRCANA, KANTAR et data sharing enseigne)

- Outils – La création de tableaux de bord pour améliorer le suivi des performances sera important sur ce poste.

- Plans merchandising – L’analyse, l’élaboration ainsi que la participation aux recommandations de plans merchandising conjointement avec le Category manager seront essentiels au bon fonctionnement des activités.

- Préparation des RDV clients et internes – Vous aiderez à préparer des points business équipe hebdomadaire et avec les fonctions supports (Supply Chain, Revenue Growth Management, eCommerce, Force de Vente)

-

- Interface Terrain – Vous partagerez les priorités enseignes sur les 4P suite aux analyses des chiffres d’affaires magasins avec la Force de Ventes.

Nous Cherchons Une Personne Qui

-

- Vous êtes en stage de césure ou de fin d’étude et avez déjà effectué une expérience significative en entreprise. Une expérience en grande distribution est un plus.

- Votre capacité d’analyse, rigueur, curiosité et votre capacité d’initiatives vous seront de véritables atouts pour la réussite de vos missions.

jobs.title: FP&A Coordinator
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about financial planning and ready to influence strategic business decisions? Join our Finance team as an FP&A Coordinator . You’ll be responsible for leading financial planning processes, designing the company’s financial architecture, and delivering critical financial insights that support decision-making across the organization. This role partners closely with Commercial, Marketing, Supply Chain, and Leadership teams to drive profitable growth, enhance reporting capabilities, and provide visibility into business performance across multiple markets.

As a key member of the FP&A team, you will lead budgeting and forecasting processes, deliver actionable financial analysis, and ensure the accuracy and quality of financial reporting. This role offers high exposure to senior leadership through weekly business updates, monthly outlook presentations, and participation in annual planning cycles.

A Taste of What You’ll Be Doing

• Financial Planning & Forecasting: Lead the annual planning process end-to-end, developing budgets, forecasts, and long-range financial plans that support business objectives.
• Business Partnership: Collaborate with Commercial, Marketing, SRM, and Supply Chain teams to align sales, profitability, and investment targets across the organization.
• Performance Analysis & Insights: Monitor business performance, analyze key financial drivers, and provide weekly and monthly insights to leadership for strategic decision-making.
• Financial Modeling & Risk Assessment: Develop financial models to evaluate business scenarios, macroeconomic impacts, sourcing strategies, transportation costs, and foreign exchange exposure across multiple markets.
• Reporting & Controls Excellence: Continuously improve financial reporting tools and processes, ensuring accurate, timely, and high-quality reports that support organizational goals.

We’re Looking for Someone With

• Bachelor’s Degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Economics, Finance, or related field.
• +3 years of experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Finance, or related areas, with direct exposure to P&L management (5+ years preferred).
• Strong expertise in financial modeling, forecasting, budgeting, reporting, and financial performance management.
• Advanced Excel skills are required, including a high level of speed and efficiency for daily financial analysis and reporting.
• Solid understanding of accounting principles, financial statements, and P&L management.
• Strong analytical, mathematical, problem-solving, decision-making, and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
• Advanced English proficiency required.

What’s Next

jobs.description:
Who are we?

Kellanova is now part of Mars Snacking, and this role exists within the “Accelerator” division of Mars Snacking. Accelerator is Mars Snacking's growth engine, focused on unlocking growth across high-potential categories and brands. Within Accelerator, the Better   For   You   portfolio includes KIND ® , RXBAR ® , Nutri-Grain ® , Special K Bars ® , and Pure Organic ® and within Tasty & Wholesome, the portfolio includes Eggo, Rice Krispies Treats, Pop Tarts, and MorningStar Farms.    Combining the scale of Mars with the agility of a growth business, we are driving innovation, accelerating performance, and transforming how we work through data, automation, and AI-enabled solutions.

We’re   looking for passionate collaborators to help us become the foremost leader in Mars Snacking and positively   impact   society along the way. If   you ’ re   looking to be a part of an inspiring,   energetic   and entrepreneurial environment,   you ’ ve   found the right place.

What   you ’ ll   do

Step into the pivotal role of Senior Operations Supervisor at our Rome, GA plant, where you’ll play a key role in driving operational success within our food manufacturing operations. This is an on-site, night shift position (4:30 PM – 5:30 AM; flexibility required) , placing you at the center of production and leadership activity.

You’ll lead a dynamic team focused on delivering results across safety, quality, and efficiency while supporting daily processing and packaging operations. This role offers the opportunity to make a real impact—leading continuous improvement initiatives, optimizing processes, and developing frontline talent within a highly collaborative and performance-driven environment.

A Taste of What You’ll Be Doing

- Drive Continuous Improvement – Identify and eliminate cost and waste by applying Kellanova Work Systems (KWS/TPM) principles and leading site-wide continuous improvement initiatives.

- Enhance Safety And Quality – Implement best practices for safety, quality, and equipment reliability, using problem-solving and root cause analysis to address operational challenges.

- Coach And Develop Teams – Build team capability by coaching employees, supporting pillar/grassroots teams, and fostering a culture of accountability and inclusion.

- Optimize Performance – Monitor schedule adherence and adjust plans based on downtime, inventory, and demand fluctuations while minimizing unplanned downtime through effective equipment management

- High School Diploma or equivalent

jobs.title: Financial Analyst -Supply Chain Finance
jobs.description:
Financial Analyst -Supply Chain Finance ( 契約社員 )

- Intro to the job （業務概要）

- ファイナンス部門は、健全な事業運営と持続的な成長を支えるため、事業パフォーマンスの分析や意思決定支援を行っています。

- Supply Chain Finance チーム は、サプライチェーン全体に関わるコスト構造の可視化と最適化を通じて、ビジネスの意思決定を支える重要なファイナンス機能です。

- 本ポジションでは、製造、供給計画、物流、購買、エンジニアリングなどの関係部門と連携しながら、各種分析やレポーティング業務を担当いただきます。

- Location of the role （勤務地）

- 群馬県高崎市台新田町 250 番地 日本ケロッグ合同会社　高崎工場

- フレックスタイム制

- リモートワーク可、最低週 3 日出社

- Brief overview of the team （所属するチームの概要）

- サプライチェーンファイナンスは経営管理・財務本部 ( ファイナンス部門 ) の１チームです

- 群馬県高崎市の高崎工場オフィスをベースとします

- １名のマネージャーと 2 名のスタッフから構成されます

- What makes the role exciting （本ポジションの魅力）

- サプライチェーン全体のコスト構造や業務プロセスについて理解を深めることができます

- 製造コスト、物流費、在庫などの分析を通じてビジネス運営を支える重要な役割を担います

- 様々な部門と連携しながら、実践的なファイナンススキルや分析スキルを身につけることができます

- データ分析やレポーティングを通じて、業務改善や意思決定支援に貢献する機会があります

A Taste of What You’ll Be Doing 　（主な職務）

- 月次決算・レポート・分析業務 － 製造原価および売上原価に関する月次決算業務をサポートし、予実分析ならびに社内およびリージョン向けレポーティングを行います。

- 予算編成とコスト管理 – 製造原価 / 売上原価の年間予算策定および予実差異分析をサポートします。関係部門と連携しながら、コスト削減施策の推進や売上原価削減目標の進捗管理を支援します。

-   在庫管理・分析業務 – 在庫予算策定および実績との差異分析を実施します。サプライチェーンチームと連携し、在庫水準の適正化やキャッシュ改善に向けた分析・提案をサポートします。

- 固定資産管理 － 工場における固定資産の管理（取得、移動、除却、減価償却など）を担当し、資産台帳の正確性維持を支援します。また、建設仮勘定の管理や実地棚卸を通じて、適切な財務統制の維持に貢献します。

- コンプライアンス・財務統制 － サプライチェーンファイナンス領域において、 SOX404 テスト、内部監査、外部監査法人による監査対応をサポートし、財務統制の維持・強化に貢献します。

- その他 － 部内の他チームや海外の業務委託先と連携し、業務プロセスの改善を支援します。工場長、財務本部長、リージョンや他国拠点の関係者などからの依頼に対応し、必要な支援を行います。

We’re Looking for Someone With 　（必須スキルと経験）

- 財務会計もしくは FP&A 部門での 3 年以上の勤務経験

- 簿記の基礎知識

- エクセル中級以上 (VLOOKUP, SUMIF, Pivot table, グラフ作成など )

- データ分析・活用スキル、ロジカルシンキング

Preferred Qualifications

- 日常会話レベルの英語能力（ライティング＆スピーキング）

- SAP FI/MM/FA 利用経験
